structural_discrepancy.note: The platform's calibrated calc_lindqvist uses a 3-component decomposition (submersion + bending + clearing) with Fn_ice dependence, whereas the original Lindqvist (1989) four-component model is crushing + bending + submersion + momentum. The platform model is therefore a *calibrated variant*, not the original verbatim — the GAP-ICE-LIT-TRANSCRIPT M1 threshold (>=4 verbatim triples) is NOT met by it.

A future agent WITH an authorised copy of the source can use this to close the M1 gap.
